values.description: Base URL of the running Express server. Matches PORT env var (default 3000).
Fixed API prefix mounted in src/app.js
Must match the ADMIN_TOKEN env var the server was started with. If the server has no ADMIN_TOKEN set, GET /config/rules is open and this value is ignored.
Optional client-supplied X-Request-Id. Leave empty to let the server generate a UUID; requests that set this header use {{$guid}} inline instead.
Absolute path to the repo's real test fixture files, reused here as sample upload payloads.
